dialogues.en:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,8)>Hm... You’re an odd <$cdef(27)>Ditto.
<$comeff(8,6)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,5)>Did you and your friends construct this building?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,8)>Hm... Você é um estranho <$cdef(27)>Ditto.
<$comeff(8,6)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,5)>Tu e os teus amigos construíram este edifício?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,806)><$voicel(8,3)>I see... I was concerned that humans might be using the
power of their so-called science <$comeff(8,14)><$motion(8,802)><$voicel(8,4)>in unwise ways again...
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,7)>But to hear that this large building was erected by
Pokémon is quite a surprise.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,806)><$voicel(8,3)>Estou a ver... estava preocupado que os humanos pudessem estar a usar o...
poder da sua chamada ciência <$comeff(8,14)><$motion(8,802)><$voicel(8,4)>De maneiras insensatas outra vez...
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,7)>Mas ouvir que este grande edifício foi erguido por
Pokémon é uma grande surpresa.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(8,5)><$motion(8,662)><$voicel(8,5)>I...am a Pokémon who was created by humans.
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,806)><$voicel(8,3)>I was concerned that humans might be using the power of
their so-called science <$comeff(8,14)><$motion(8,802)><$voicel(8,4)>in unwise ways again...
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,7)>But if this large building was indeed constructed by
Pokémon—well, that’s quite the surprise.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(8,5)><$motion(8,662)><$voicel(8,5)>Eu... sou um Pokémon que foi criado por humanos.
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,806)><$voicel(8,3)>Estava preocupado que os humanos pudessem estar a usar o poder de
a sua chamada ciência <$comeff(8,14)><$motion(8,802)><$voicel(8,4)>De maneiras insensatas outra vez...
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,7)>Mas se este grande edifício foi realmente construído por
Pokémon — bem, essa é uma grande surpresa.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,802)><$voicel(8,2)>I do not know.
<$comeff(8,14)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,3)>The last time I saw a human was in a city where rain no
longer fell... <$comeff(8,20)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,8)>I believe it was called <$cdef(27)>Fuchsia.
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,5)>They were putting up a peculiar building on a
nearby beach.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,802)><$voicel(8,2)>Não sei.
<$comeff(8,14)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,3)>A última vez que vi um humano foi numa cidade onde choveu não.
mais tempo caiu... <$comeff(8,20)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,8)>Creio que se chamava <$cdef(27)>Fuchsia.
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,5)>Eles estavam a montar um edifício peculiar sobre um
praia próxima.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,802)><$voicel(8,3)>I think it highly likely that they were plotting something
nefarious.
<$comeff(8,6)><$motion(8,807)><$voicel(8,7)>If you’re curious about humans, I suggest you investigate
around there.
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,3)>Although...a great deal of time has passed. I can’t be sure
that the building still exists.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,802)><$voicel(8,3)>Eu acho que é altamente provável que eles estavam tramando algo
Nefasto.
<$comeff(8,6)><$motion(8,807)><$voicel(8,7)>Se você está curioso sobre os humanos, sugiro que você investigue
Por ali.
<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,3)>Embora ... uma grande quantidade de tempo passou. Eu não posso ter certeza
que o edifício ainda existe.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(8,14)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,5)>Hmmm... I don’t usually speak at such length. <$comeff(8,9)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,10)>Perhaps this
is a sign that I’ve taken a liking to you.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(8,14)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,5)>Hmmm... Eu não costumo falar com tanta distância. <$comeff(8,9)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,10)>Talvez isto.
é um sinal de que eu tenho gostado de você.

<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>I can’t believe an incredible Pokémon like that came all

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,9)>Oh my, oh my! Were they terribly good-looking?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,9)>Meu Deus, eram muito bonitos?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>So tell us, did <$cdef(27)>Mewtwo </color>say anything about the humans?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Então, diz-nos, fizeste... <$cdef(27)>Mewtwo </color>Diz alguma coisa sobre os humanos?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Really? Well, that’s unfortunate!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>But it did seem like you two were talking for quite a while.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Are you certain they didn’t tell you ANYTHING about the
humans? Really try to remember.

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Realmente? Bem, isso é lamentável!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>I hope we can continue working together like this so that
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>all Pokémon in all the towns can live comfortably!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Espero que possamos continuar a trabalhar juntos desta forma.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>todos os Pokémon em todas as cidades podem viver confortavelmente!

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Please come back here soon and tell us what you learned!
